newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldier wounded in Lebanon fighting.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier wounded in Lebanon fighting.

text.p: An Israeli soldier was wounded in clashes with Lebanese fighters in south Lebanon on Sunday, Israeli security sources said.
Lebanon's Hizbollah said its fighters waged two attacks against Israeli forces in south Lebanon on Sunday, causing casualties and damage.

The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said in a statement in Beirut its fighters opened fire twice at an armoured force in the Basseel area in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, "inflicting a number of casualties, dead and wounded".
In Israel, security sources said one soldier was wounded.

On Saturday, Hizbollah guerrillas killed an Israeli soldier and wounded two when they opened machinegun and anti-tank rocket fire at an Israeli post at Blat in the western sector of the occupation zone.
Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war in a bid to oust Israeli and allied militia forces from the 15-km (nine-mile) deep zone in south Lebanon.
Some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong pro-Israeli South Lebanon Army militia patrol the zone set up in 1985 to deter cross-border guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
